decided.question: does a client principal calling GET /api/organizations/{orgId}/request-topics get the catalogue (200) or REQ-03-019's default refusal (404)
decided.chose: 404 — the route falls under REQ-03-019's default deny, since it is not among the requirement's named exceptions
decided.rejected: leaving the route open to a client principal because the new-request modal reads it
decided.why: fail-safe (decision order step 3): a client contact cannot raise a request at all (REQ-03-027), so there is no legitimate read for them to make on this route, and refusing it keeps REQ-03-019 an exhaustive default-deny list rather than one silently punctured by an unlisted route
decided.recordedAt: contracts.md's Routes section prose (the paragraph explaining which routes are listed and why) and the route's own '### GET .../request-topics' subsection now state the client principal meets 404 there; the main spec's AC-3 now names the request-topics route alongside members, projects and contacts; TC-03-INT-13 in cases.md now asserts the 404 and its Steps call the route
